## PHASE 2 — SCORING & RANKING
Score every deduplicated issue 1–10 on each criterion; show the math.

| Criterion | Weight | What to look at |
|---|---|---|
| Engagement | 25% | interactions per post; number of posts across the web; breadth of sources |
| Feasibility | 20% | can the social-investigation method be applied (accessible people, concrete local problem, interviewable affected parties)? Specificity = credibility |
| Return potential | 20% | likelihood that organized effort produces visible, material results for the community/workers |
| Worker alignment | 20% | does the issue sit on working-class material interests (wages, housing, healthcare, utilities, workplace, food)? |
| Dual-power potential | 15% | does work on this issue build durable community infrastructure, legitimacy, and independent organization? |
